description: This file implements the MockPersistentNelStore class and its nested Command class, which are used for testing network error logging policies in Chromium. It includes methods for managing commands related to network error logging policies, such as load, add, update, delete, and flush operations.

classes.name: MockPersistentNelStore::Command
classes.description: Represents a command for managing network error logging policies, including types like load, add, update, delete, and flush, with associated data such as policy key and callback.

methods.name: MockPersistentNelStore::Command::Command
methods.description: Constructors for the Command class, initializing command type and associated data.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Equality operator for comparing two Command objects based on type and key.

methods.name: MockPersistentNelStore::LoadNelPolicies
methods.description: Initiates loading of NEL policies and stores the callback.

methods.name: MockPersistentNelStore::AddNelPolicy
methods.description: Adds a new NEL policy to the command list.

methods.name: MockPersistentNelStore::UpdateNelPolicyAccessTime
methods.description: Updates the access time for a given NEL policy.

methods.name: MockPersistentNelStore::Flush
methods.description: Flushes the command list, updating policy count.

methods.name: MockPersistentNelStore::FinishLoading
methods.description: Completes the loading process, invoking callbacks with policies.

methods.name: MockPersistentNelStore::VerifyCommands
methods.description: Verifies if the command list matches expected commands.
